## Why

`npm run check` fails locally whenever a Claude Code session has a git worktree under `.claude/worktrees/`, such as `.claude/worktrees/itinerary-read-size`. ESLint runs on `.`, so it lints the worktree's files too. Each one fails with "Parsing error: No tsconfigRootDir was set, and multiple candidate TSConfigRootDirs are present", since the worktree has its own `tsconfig.json`. The pre-commit hook runs the check, so no commit can be made in the main checkout while such a worktree exists. Git already ignores `.claude/worktrees/` (`.gitignore`), and CI's check runs on a clean checkout, so only local runs are hit. Prettier runs only on `src` and `web`, and Vitest found no tests there, so only ESLint needs the change.

It came up while making #144. That commit skipped the hook with `LEFTHOOK=0`, after format, types, lint on `src web *.config.ts`, and the tests were each run by hand and passed.

## Design

- [DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md), sections 1 (the one check) and 6 (config files change only with Joe's approval).

## Open questions

None yet.

## Do

- **Add `.claude/worktrees/` to `globalIgnores()` in `eslint.config.mjs`,** and to the comment above it, saying a Claude Code session's worktree is a full copy of the repo. This is a config file, so it needs Joe's approval (DEVELOPMENT.md section 6).

## Done when

- With a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/`, `npm run check` passes in the main checkout.

## Ends in

A PR.
